newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks smash yet another high at close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks smash yet another high at close.

text.p: Madrid stocks smashed yet another closing high on Monday, adding a record amount on the back of an unstoppable wave of investor enthusiasm, dealers said.
At one point today, investors were buying stocks "of any type, at any price," according to a fund manager.
A seemingly insatiable appetite for shares by retail investors after the fall in interest rates is pushing the market beyond levels forecast for this year as a whole, dealers said.
The fact that April inflation is expected to be at least below two percent on Wednesday, prompting another rate cut on Friday, is also at the centre of trade, they added.
The general index rose 12.63 points, 2.38 percent, to 544.31 and the Ibex added 2.54 percent, 155.67 points, to 6,283.74

Telefonica rose 145 pesetas to 4,055 pesetas, a new closing high, after announcing a 15.7 percent gain in first quarter profits. Traders said the results fell short of expectations, but this did not stop the shares gaining sharply.
Some said strong volume today might indicate that institutional investors are taking positions in the firm.
Banesto increased its record-breaking run, adding 12.5 percent to 1,675, although there was no consensus on why.
